<result>## Report — Fire Escape (`primitive:cube:3`, lane-fire_escape)

**Final state:** 63 authored regions / 126 triangles, `unnamed: 0`, `0 intersecting · 0 unreachable`, `save` returned `ok:true`.

**Method:** Pure box-modeling from the single seeded cube, since this is a background/non-active-tab lane where `add` is refused. All geometry is one continuous connected shell built by alternating `extrude` (plain, along face normal) and `move` (arbitrary delta) to turn extrude caps into zigzag/raked members, plus `basic-cut` to carve corner footprints for posts.

**Authored regions (bbox in meters):**
- `deck.top/underside/left/right` + `wallMount.cap/.wall` — landing platform, 1.2w × 0.08h × 0.9d at y=[1.62,1.70], flush wall flange to y=0.57 (back).
- `riser1..4.wall`, `tread1..4.cap/.wall` — straight 4-step stair flight, built as an alternating vertical-riser/horizontal-tread extrude chain. Rise 0.405 m/step × 4 = exactly 1.62 m (deck height, lands at y≈0). Going 0.175 m/step + hairline; stair front reaches z=-1.23.
- `railTL/railTR.cap/.wall` + `railFront.cap/.wall` — landing guardrail: two corner posts (y 1.70→2.60) joined by a solid guard panel across the full 1.2 m front edge.
- `railBL/railBR.cap/.wall` — guard posts at the base of the stair flight (y 0.08→0.88), flanking the bottom tread.

**Overall envelope:** 1.2 w (x −0.6..0.6) × 2.6 h (y 0..2.6) × ~1.8 d (z 0.57 wall to −1.23 stair front). Depth exceeds the ~0.9 m target because a functional stair descending 1.62 m needs run — I compressed it to a steep ~66° pitch (realistic for fire-escape ladders) rather than shrink it further; flagging this deviation rather than silently padding the numbers.

**Refusals hit + adaptations:**
- `add`/`part-*`/`shot`/`viewport` etc. — anticipated background-lane refusals per the skill; never attempted, built everything via box-modeling instead.
- `extrude-edge` on a horizontal edge extended coplanar with the adjacent face (confirmed empirically) rather than turning a corner — abandoned for stair construction in favor of the extrude+move technique.
- An `extrude(hairline)` → `move(pure vertical, −0.9)` chain from a cap that had itself resulted from a large prior lateral move produced 3 self-intersecting + 10 unreachable triangles (isolated via `select-audit`). Undone; rebuilt the same joint using only plain, unchained extrudes from fresh cut corners — resolved cleanly.
- Joining three independently-extruded landing-rail pieces (two posts + panel) left 8 internal mating faces "unreachable" at the seams (classic touching-solids case from the finish-gate doc). Located via `select-audit '{"kind":"unreachable"}'`, deleted precisely those 8 faces — outer skin was already continuous from shared cut vertices, so no bridging/welding was needed; audit went to 0/0.
- `semantic-status` refused with the documented "UV/paint focus bridge belongs to the visible ModelView" reason (background target `primitive:cube:3` ≠ active `primitive:cube:10`) — expected per the background-lane rules; `save ok:true` is the durable-state evidence available from this lane.

Model saved and claim dismissed (`tools/seat dismiss` → `ok:true`).</result>
